spells.name: Bless Water
spells.summary: Imbue water with positive energy to create holy water.

spells.name: Bless Weapon
spells.summary: Make a weapon strike true against evil foes.

spells.name: Create Water
spells.summary: Create 2 gallons of pure water per caster level.

spells.name: Cure Light Wounds
spells.summary: Heal 1d8 hit points plus 1 per caster level, to a maximum of +5.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.summary: Gain a luck bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls.

spells.name: Restoration, Lesser
spells.summary: Dispel a magical ability penalty or repair 1d4 points of ability damage.

spells.name: Virtue
spells.summary: Grant the subject 1 temporary hit point.

spells.name: Delay Poison
spells.summary: Stop poison from harming the subject for 1 hour per caster level.

spells.name: Remove Paralysis
spells.summary: Free one or more creatures from paralysis or a slow effect.

spells.name: Shield Other
spells.summary: Take half of the warded subject's damage.

spells.name: Undetectable Alignment
spells.summary: Conceal a creature or object's alignment for 24 hours.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.summary: Prevent affected creatures from speaking deliberate lies.

spells.name: Cure Moderate Wounds
spells.summary: Heal 2d8 hit points plus 1 per caster level, to a maximum of +10.

spells.name: Discern Lies
spells.summary: Reveal deliberate falsehoods spoken by observed subjects.

spells.name: Heal Mount
spells.summary: Restore a paladin's special mount as the heal spell.

spells.name: Prayer
spells.summary: Grant allies bonuses and impose matching penalties on enemies.

spells.name: Remove Blindness/Deafness
spells.summary: Cure normal or magical blindness or deafness.

spells.name: Cure Serious Wounds
spells.summary: Heal 3d8 hit points plus 1 per caster level, to a maximum of +15.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.summary: Protect a subject from death effects, energy drain, and negative energy.

spells.name: Dispel Chaos
spells.summary: Gain protection from chaotic creatures and dispel or banish chaos.

spells.name: Dispel Evil
spells.summary: Gain protection from evil creatures and dispel or banish evil.

spells.name: Holy Sword
spells.summary: Make a weapon +5 and holy, with a protective magic circle.

spells.name: Mark of Justice
spells.summary: Designate an action that triggers a curse on the subject.

spells.name: Neutralize Poison
spells.summary: Detoxify venom and grant temporary immunity to poison.

spells.name: Restoration
spells.summary: Restore drained levels and ability scores and remove fatigue or exhaustion.
